title: Hyperboloidal evolution for scalar scattering in Minkowski space
summary: We develop a time-domain numerical framework for global scalar wave scattering in Minkowski spacetime. The main contribution is an exact conformal matching of three compactified regions: a past hyperboloidal domain attached to $\mathscr I^-$, a Penrose domain covering a neighborhood of spatial infinity $i^0$, and a future hyperboloidal domain attached to $\mathscr I^+$. The matching surfaces are identical conformal hypersurfaces in the adjacent charts.
